before-starting-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 1
before-starting-perilous-moons.text: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?

before-starting-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 2
before-starting-perilous-moons.text: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?

before-starting-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 1
before-starting-perilous-moons.text: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?

before-starting-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 2
before-starting-perilous-moons.text: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.

steps.speaker: Builder 1
steps.text: We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.

steps.player: Have you tried asking them to move?

steps.speaker: Builder 2
steps.text: We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.

steps.speaker: Builder 2
steps.text: But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.

steps.player: It's not just humans that do those things.

steps.speaker: Builder 2
steps.text: Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.

after-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 1
after-perilous-moons.text: Good to see you again, mate.

after-perilous-moons.player: Good to see you both as well. How's things?

after-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 2
after-perilous-moons.text: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!

after-perilous-moons.speaker: Builder 1
after-perilous-moons.text: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
